body_text:
Cayley--Hamilton theorem. Every square matrix satisfies its own
characteristic polynomial: $\chi_A(A)=0$. This converts high
powers of $A$ into linear combinations of lower powers and is a
basic bridge between polynomial algebra and linear operators.
